answer: The kernel escrow is released only against a reef receipt, and the wander audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 18 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 173 aliases means carrying 234 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
